Effect_Description: Boosts processing speed by 200%. Enables multi-system simultaneous hack. Overheats after 30s continuous use.
Lore_Notes: Developed by the Voss Collective as a performance enhancement. Early models caused psychic feedback — the current version is merely dangerous.

Effect_Description: Adaptive camouflage that bends light around the wearer. Reduces detection range by 75%. Degrades in extreme heat.
Lore_Notes: Woven from a material recovered from the Void Rift. The Syndicate reverse-engineered it from a Void Walker's cloak.

Effect_Description: Channels Void energy into a focused beam that ignores all physical armor. Causes dimensional instability on hit. 10% chance to open a rift.
Lore_Notes: One of three weapons known to affect entities that exist outside normal reality. The other two are unaccounted for.

Effect_Description: Electrified short blade that chains lightning between adjacent enemies. Deals bonus damage to mechanical targets.
Lore_Notes: Standard-issue sidearm for mid-tier Ironveil soldiers. Many have been stolen and modified by Drifter mechanics.

Effect_Description: Projects a bio-energetic barrier absorbing up to 500 damage before breaking. Regenerates over 60s. Immune to toxin damage.
Lore_Notes: A Voss Collective innovation. The shield is technically alive — a thin layer of engineered organisms that sacrifice themselves to protect the wearer.

Effect_Description: Living armor that absorbs nature energy. Grants slow health regeneration in natural zones. Hardens to stone vs fire damage.
Lore_Notes: Grown rather than forged. The Root Covenant grows these mantles over decades. Accepting one is considered a sacred honor.

Effect_Description: Augmented gauntlets that amplify both physical strikes and arcane channeling. Melee hits deal bonus resonance damage.
Lore_Notes: Salvaged from a pre-Collapse military prototype. Someone was building soldiers who could fight both physically and magically.

Effect_Description: Fires a supercharged plasma burst that destroys cover and deals massive AOE damage. Single-use charge per battle.
Lore_Notes: The weapon that ended the Shattered Peaks War. The Empire claims only 12 were ever built. The Ashenveil Clan says there were 20 — and they have 8.

Effect_Description: Full-spectrum stealth cloak. Renders wearer invisible to cameras, heat sensors, AI detection, and Void sight for 45s.
Lore_Notes: Standard issue for Phantom Bureau field agents. The manufacturing facility's location is one of the most guarded secrets in the Miraverse.

Effect_Description: All market prices reduced by 10%. Grants access to hidden merchant dialogue options. Recognized by all Guild members.
Drop_Source: Port Mira merchant quest reward / Purchase
Lore_Notes: Every Merchant Guild member receives one upon joining. The ring contains an encrypted signal that identifies the wearer to Guild security systems.

Effect_Description: Allows wearer to see through walls, detect Void entities, read digital code in physical space, and spot hidden compartments.
Lore_Notes: Grown from a crystallized fragment of Void energy. The Void Walkers consider anyone wearing one to be partially in the Void.

Effect_Description: Injects malicious code directly into digital systems or augmented targets. Disables electronic enemies for 15s. Lethal to high-augmentation NPCs.
Lore_Notes: Originally a network admin tool. Hackers quickly realized its offensive potential. The Syndicate sells millions of modified versions.

Effect_Description: Detonates a burst of Void energy that disrupts all abilities and defenses in the blast radius for 10s.
Lore_Notes: The Root Covenant has banned these weapons from Rootveil territory. They leave scars on reality that take decades to heal.

Effect_Description: Reinforced power gauntlets that boost melee damage by 20% and grant immunity to disarm effects.
Lore_Notes: Standard Ironveil heavy infantry gear. Halvorn's personal pair are said to be laced with a special alloy found only in the Undervault.

Effect_Description: Translates all ancient languages automatically. Doubles lore XP from codex collection. Identifies all plants and organisms.
Lore_Notes: Developed by House Solenne to allow scholars to read pre-Collapse texts. ORACLE-9 contributed the core translation matrix.

Effect_Description: Increases movement speed by 35% in urban environments. Enables wall-running for 3s. Reduces fall damage by 80%.
Lore_Notes: Designed by Neon Sprawl street racers. The Drifters adopted them for quick escapes. Every courier in the city wears a pair.

Effect_Description: Semi-automatic plasma rifle. Rounds pierce light armor. Extended barrel for +30% range. Overcharge mode deals 3x damage with 10s cooldown.
Lore_Notes: Standard issue for Imperial mid-tier soldiers. Thousands are in circulation. The Drifters have modified more Ember Core Rifles than the Empire has issued.

Effect_Description: Bracers woven with living thornwood. Reflect 15% melee damage to attacker. Buff nature-based abilities by 20%.
Lore_Notes: The thorns are alive. They grow slightly over time and must be trimmed by a Root Covenant warden — or they'll grow into the wearer's skin.

Effect_Description: Passive environmental scanner. Detects all loot, hidden passages, traps, and NPCs within 50m. Updates player map in real time.
Lore_Notes: Originally designed for geological surveys in the Undervault. The Architects still use the original spec. Everyone else uses a Syndicate knockoff.

Effect_Description: Forged from black Void-crystal. Deals bonus damage to void-touched enemies. Poison chance on hit (15%). Ignores 25% of target armor.
Lore_Notes: The signature weapon of Syndicate inner-circle enforcers. Black Jade carries the original. Replicas exist but are noticeably inferior.

Effect_Description: Reduces heat and sand damage to zero. Prevents tracking in desert environments. Camouflage in sand-colored terrain.
Lore_Notes: Every Dawnrider scout gets one on their first long desert run. The weave pattern is clan-specific — outsiders can spot a fake immediately.

Effect_Description: Amplifies spell damage by 30%. Reduces arcane spell cooldowns by 20%. Shatters if the wearer takes more than 500 damage at once.
Lore_Notes: A naturally occurring formation from the Void Rift. The Void Walkers consider taking them from the Rift to be theft from the Void itself.

Effect_Description: Blocks all communication signals in 100m radius. Disables NPC call-for-backup ability. Disrupts drone navigation.
Lore_Notes: A staple of Drifter operations. Every major Syndicate heist uses at least three. The Empire has been trying to ban them for 15 years.

Effect_Description: Absorbs 1000 damage before breaking. Bash attack stuns enemies for 3s. Legendary version is indestructible.
Lore_Notes: Carried by Halvorn's personal guard. The family crest is embossed in a metal that predates the First Collapse. No one knows what it is.

Effect_Description: Heads-up display overlaying real-time tactical data, NPC profiles, faction affiliation, and environmental threats.
Lore_Notes: Developed by House Prismwatch. The most popular piece of personal tech in the Citadel. The Syndicate version has a hidden data-skimmer.

Effect_Description: Close-range blast that deals both physical and nature damage. Secondary fire launches a root grenade that immobilizes.
Lore_Notes: Created by Root Covenant warriors who were forced to fight Industrial encroachment. The roots in the barrel are alive and must be watered.

Effect_Description: Stores up to 50 NPC conversation records. Replays any past dialogue on demand. Auto-identifies lies in real-time.
Lore_Notes: Based on ORACLE-9's memory architecture. The Archivist is believed to be running an early version of this technology.

Effect_Description: Phases through armor on every third strike. Leaves a temporary rift scar on target that doubles damage from subsequent void attacks.
Lore_Notes: A weapon that exists in two states simultaneously — physical and digital. Only someone with a stable neural interface can hold it without it phasing away.

Effect_Description: Grants diplomatic immunity in Republic-controlled regions. Unlocks special dialogue with Republic NPCs. Prevents hostile action from Republic faction members.
Lore_Notes: Issued by the Citadel Council. Every major faction knows what it means — and most respect it, if only out of political calculation.

Effect_Description: Stabilizes the wearer's physical form against Void distortion. Grants immunity to dimensional damage. Allows extended Void zone presence.
Lore_Notes: The only known device that allows non-Void-born individuals to survive extended exposure to the Void Rift core. Sable designed it herself.
